meta.source: Sngular Brand Book 2025 (PDF) + 2025 Editable Slide Guides and Templates + sngular.com

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Primary. Main brand color: titles, paragraphs on light backgrounds, and dark backgrounds (covers, dividers). Navy text on white 17.5:1, on navy-light 15.8:1.

tokens.name: navy-light
tokens.usage: Primary. Relief background: panels, bands, and light section dividers. Never as text on white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primary. Default background and text on navy or blue.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary. Corporate blue: cursor, text highlight, special titles, Heading 2, primary action. As text: on white 4.52:1 (meets AA). On navy-light 4.07:1 and on navy 3.88:1: large text only (24px+ or 18.66px+ semibold).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Secondary (accent, max. 5% of the composition). Icons, lines, and small elements. Never for titles or boxes with a lot of text. As text on white 4.51:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Secondary (accent, max. 5%). Icons, lines, and details on navy (11.8:1). Never as text on white (1.49:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Secondary (accent, max. 5%) and UI error signal. Icons, borders, and details. On white 3.89:1: don't use for small text; on navy 4.5:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page, slide, or screen background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate background: panels, bands, alternating table rows, Navy Light section divider.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark background: cover, Navy section divider, closing, web footer. All text on top in ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and titles on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Derived for UI (not in the brand book): navy at 70% for metadata, photo captions, and copyright. ≈6.6:1 on white, ≈6.2:1 on navy-light.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse (navy) or on blue.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Derived for UI: rules, dividers, and table borders (navy at 16%).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Derived for UI: form field border (navy at 56%, ≈4:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, links, cursor, and highlight.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (primary button, highlighted text, special title): 4.52:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid at 2px offset from the element on light backgrounds; use white on navy.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: UI error: field icon and border. The error message goes in ink, accompanied by the icon in danger.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Derived for UI (not in the brand book): confirmation as text or icon on white (≥4.5:1). Use green on navy.

tokens.name: chart-violet
tokens.usage: Alternative palette, only for charts and roadmaps with many series. Never predominant.

tokens.name: chart-bolt
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts.

tokens.name: chart-sky
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts. On white it falls short of 3:1: pair with a label.

tokens.name: chart-mint
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts. On white it falls short of 3:1: pair with a label.

tokens.name: chart-lime
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts. On white it falls short of 3:1: pair with a label.

tokens.name: chart-sun
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts. Better on navy (12.9:1).

tokens.name: chart-coral
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts.

tokens.name: chart-magenta
tokens.usage: Alternative palette for charts.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Standalone headline of maximum impact (cover, hero). Only paired with paragraph-big.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Featured headline for a section or statement slide.

styles.name: display-2-regular
styles.usage: Lighter variant of display-2, for long phrases or quotes.

styles.name: heading-1-light
styles.usage: Slide title in an editorial tone; combines with Highlight.

styles.name: paragraph-big
styles.sample: In the fast-paced realm of technology, crafting texts that captivate and inform.
styles.usage: Paragraph that accompanies a display headline. Never alongside other paragraph styles.

styles.name: paragraph
styles.sample: In the fast-paced realm of technology, crafting texts that captivate and inform.
styles.usage: Standard paragraph in slides and desktop web. Highlight with 700 (Outfit Bold) or Highlight.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Categorizes or introduces a title. Always uppercase.

styles.name: auxiliary
styles.usage: Auxiliary text: secondary details, captions, sources, copyright.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Leave us your details and we will get in touch.
styles.usage: Derived for UI: body text on mobile screens and forms.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Derived for UI: buttons, tabs, and field labels.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Derived for UI: field hints, notes, and metadata. In ink or ink-muted.

spacing.note: Base-8px scale (derived for web and apps). Slide margins come from the brand book (1920×1080 canvas).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Minimum spacing: icon-to-text within a button.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Spacing between overline and title; padding of highlighted text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of fields; gap between inline elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a large button; gap between paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between blocks in a row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between title and content; column gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Spacing between sections of a page.

tokens.name: slide-margin-x
tokens.usage: Brand book: side margin of the safe area on a 1920×1080 canvas. Nothing exits it except bleeding images.

tokens.name: slide-margin-y
tokens.usage: Brand book: top and bottom margin of the safe area at 1920×1080. The title aligns to the top margin.

radius.note: The brand is square: blocks, highlights, photos, and buttons have no rounding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default everywhere: buttons, cards, images, highlights, fields.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Only checkboxes and small chips in apps.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only circular avatars and the isotype in a round profile.

tokens.name: logo-min-solid
tokens.usage: Minimum digital logotype height, solid version (navy on light background, white on dark).

tokens.name: logo-min-color
tokens.usage: Minimum logotype height keeping its color versions (positive or negative).

tokens.name: cursor-text
tokens.usage: Thickness of the cursor accompanying a paragraph (measured at 1920px).

tokens.name: cursor-image
tokens.usage: Thickness of the cursor accompanying an image or panel (measured at 1920px).
